subject: general
question: According to the recent announcement by Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh, how many Doppler Weather Radars in total is India projected to have over the next two years under 'Mission Mausam'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• Union Minister **Dr. Jitendra Singh** and Uttar Pradesh CM **Yogi Adityanath** launched a new **Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC)** at **Lucknow**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• During the launch, it was highlighted that India had only **17 Doppler Weather Radars** in **2014**.
• The network has currently expanded to **50 Doppler Weather Radars** across the country.
• Under **Mission Mausam**, another **50 radars** are proposed to be installed, bringing the total to nearly **100 radars** over the next **two years**.
• This expansion is aimed at strengthening real-time weather monitoring and providing highly localized and time-specific forecasts.
• Therefore, the correct total projection under the mission is **100**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• In **Uttar Pradesh**, the number of **Automatic Weather Stations** has increased from **59 to 107** in the last decade.
• The state now has **3 operational Doppler Weather Radars**, compared to just **1 in 2014**, with **6 more** being commissioned shortly.
• **Lightning sensors** in UP have grown from **0 to 7**, and **Automatic Rain Gauges** have increased from **132 to 140**.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• The new **Regional Meteorological Centre at Lucknow** will cater to the forecasting needs of **Uttar Pradesh**, **Uttarakhand**, and adjoining regions.
• The centre aims to decentralize meteorological services and improve disaster risk reduction for events like **flash floods**, **cloudbursts**, and **heatwaves**.</ul
